Run configuration and reward comparison

Current runs use reward_mode: all_hops_correct. The binary reward is 1 only when every hop is correct. The counterfactual hop-accuracy reward shown here is correct_hops / total_hops, which is the obvious alternate test for reducing noise from useful partial rollouts.
